articles.title: SEC filing: 10-Q — Fermi Inc. (10-Q FERMI THIRD QUARTER FORM 10-Q)
articles.summary: The company's Q3 2026 filing discloses various financial and operational updates, including changes in common stock, additional paid-in capital, and retained earnings, as well as details on equipment financing, debt, and convertible senior notes. The filing also mentions specific transactions and agreements, such as the Non-Exclusive Aircraft Dry Lease Agreement with TMNN Manager LLC and the Equipment Supply Loan Financing Agreement. Additionally, the company reports on the issuance of shares to a financial advisor and the status of the Yorkville Promissory Note.

The company also published an investor presentation on its investor relations website, which is furnished as an exhibit to this report. The disclosures provide insight into the company's financial performance and condition, and the accompanying investor presentation offers additional information for investors.
